channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Saudi national prosecuted for placing hidden bug at OpenAI headquarters
item.description: Authorities report that a covert recording apparatus, concealed within toilet tissue, was discovered plugged into a television USB port inside a leadership meeting area.

item.title: Man United defender Martinez criticizes club management following defeat
item.description: Following a match loss, Lisandro Martinez harshly condemns the leadership at Manchester United for failing to add new players after securing a Champions League spot.

item.title: Pope Leo recovers in Rome following lung tumor extraction
item.description: The pontiff, aged 71, is currently recuperating at the Gemelli hospital in Rome subsequent to an operation to excise a malignant mass from his lung.

item.title: Atletico Madrid defeats Manchester United 2-0 in Champions League play
item.description: Manchester United, led by Michael Carrick, extended their winless streak after suffering a 2-0 defeat against Atletico Madrid in the UEFA Champions League.

item.title: চার গোল দিয়ে জয় তুলে নিল বার্সেলোনা
item.description: ম্যাচে এক গোল হজম করার পর দুর্দান্তভাবে ঘুরে দাঁড়িয়ে চার গোল করে জয় নিশ্চিত করেছে বার্সেলোনা।

item.title: Australian political updates on tax and resources
item.description: Treasurer Chalmers states that the ATO surcharge involved the prime minister, while a Nationals MP defends a controversial statement. Meanwhile, the Greens claim Australia misses significant resource revenue.

item.title: ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেড ও ইন্টার মিলানের পরাজয়
item.description: আতলেতিকো মাদ্রিদের কাছে দুই গোলে হেরেছে ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেড এবং ক্লাব ব্রুগার বিপক্ষে চার-তিন ব্যবধানে পরাজিত হয়েছে ইন্টার মিলান।

item.title: Indian Foreign Minister stresses stable frontier for relations with China
item.description: India's external affairs minister emphasizes that achieving normal bilateral relations with China requires maintaining a peaceful and stable border.

item.title: Zelenskyy scheduled to meet UK leader at Downing Street
item.description: Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy will visit London on Wednesday to meet with British Prime Minister Andy Burnham. The meeting aims to demonstrate strong UK backing for Ukraine following recent political challenges involving Donald Trump.

item.title: Helix Carbon proposes cheaper iron via blast furnace recycling
item.description: Startup Helix Carbon claims it can reduce steel industry emissions and production costs by upcycling pollutants generated by traditional blast furnaces.

item.title: Severe weather causes flooding and damage along Southern California coast
item.description: Intense weekend storms triggered widespread flooding, ruined a Long Beach boardwalk, and damaged homes across Southern California, Baja California, and Las Vegas.

item.title: Patna High Court overturns convictions for 13 in 1996 murder case
item.description: Judges Rajeev Ranjan Prasad and Kumar Manish acquitted thirteen defendants involved in the 1996 Jehanabad quadruple murders, pointing to serious police investigation failures.

item.title: Vatican announces successful lung surgery for Pope Leo
item.description: The Vatican reported that a medical procedure to extract a minor pulmonary growth from Pope Leo XIV was completed without complications.

item.title: Houthi blockade triggers food scarcity in Taiz
item.description: Road closures enforced by Houthi forces surrounding government-held Taiz have severely disrupted food supplies and caused shortages for residents.

item.title: Footage captures ICE vehicle hitting pedestrian in Houston
item.description: Surveillance recordings document a vehicle operated by an ICE agent colliding with 48-year-old Miguel Parra-Hernandez in Houston, Texas.

item.title: Vatican reports successful cancer surgery on Pope Leo's lung
item.description: Pope Leo XIV underwent a 90-minute Tuesday operation to extract a malignant mass from his right lung. The Vatican confirmed the pontiff regained consciousness successfully.

item.title: OpenAI Discovers Concealed Recording Tool at Headquarters
item.description: Artificial intelligence firm OpenAI reported the discovery of a concealed audio recording tool within its corporate facilities. Company personnel utilized AI systems to help identify the unknown hardware.

item.title: Vatican Reports Pope Leo Undergoes Lung Cancer Surgery
item.description: Pope Leo received a lung cancer diagnosis and underwent an operation to excise the lower portion of his right lung. The Vatican confirmed that the surgical procedure was successful.

item.title: FBI Apprehends OpenAI Staff Member Over Hidden Audio Bug
item.description: Federal authorities detained an OpenAI staff member for allegedly placing an audio recorder in a meeting space. FBI Director Kash Patel stated the plot aimed to intercept confidential discussions regarding advanced artificial intelligence.

item.title: Nineteen-Year-Old Charged with Murder in Sydney Boy's Shooting
item.description: Authorities arrested a 19-year-old male at a correctional facility on Tuesday and charged him with murder. The charge stems from the fatal shooting of a 12-year-old child in northern Sydney in September.

item.title: Duane Davis Receives 40-Year Sentence for Tupac Shakur Murder
item.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was handed a prison term of 40 years to life. The sentencing follows his conviction for the 1996 killing of rapper Tupac Shakur.

item.title: OpenAI Staff Member Arrested for Concealing Audio Bug
item.description: An employee at the artificial intelligence organization, who is a Saudi national, was detained following the discovery of a surveillance bug inside a workplace room.

item.title: Greta Gerwig's Narnia Adaptation Scheduled for February Release
item.description: Director Greta Gerwig debuted footage from her film version of "Narnia: The Magician's Nephew" in New York. The movie debuts in cinemas on February 12 and will stream on Netflix starting April 2.

item.title: Research Suggests Canids Aid Plant Dispersal in the Sahara
item.description: A recent scientific study indicates that foxes and wolves could be assisting the dissemination of flora throughout the Sahara Desert region.

item.title: Trump Dismisses US Ambassador to Greece Amid Misconduct Claims
item.description: The removal follows recent statements from Donald Trump regarding his intent to replace the envoy. The diplomat, previously linked to Fox News and the Trump family, was terminated following misconduct accusations.

item.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Concealing Recording Device in Office
item.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, was taken into custody after a hidden recording apparatus was uncovered in a company meeting space. Authorities have filed charges against the OpenAI employee related to the device.

item.title: Mourners Gather for Egyptian Flight Attendant Killed in Riyadh Strike
item.description: A funeral service was held for the Egyptian flight attendant who lost their life during a Houthi assault in Riyadh. Family and community members attended the memorial rites.

item.title: Federal Court Directs OpenAI to Produce Hiring Files for Apple Lawsuit
item.description: A judge mandated that OpenAI must surrender candidate interview documentation involving former Apple staff members. The ruling also grants Apple access to relevant private communications and key testimony.

item.title: কলকাতায় মমতার ওপর হামলার অভিযোগ ও পুলিশের বক্তব্য
item.description: মঙ্গলবার সন্ধ্যায় বাড়ি থেকে বের হওয়ার সময় তৃণমূল কংগ্রেস নেত্রী মমতা বন্দ্যোপাধ্যায়ের ওপর এক নারী ছুরি নিয়ে চড়াও হন বলে দল দাবি করেছে। তবে পুলিশ একে কেবল একটি বাকবিতণ্ডা হিসেবে উল্লেখ করেছে এবং কোনো অস্ত্রের কথা বলেনি।

item.title: Vatican Reports Pope Leo XIV Diagnosed with Lung Cancer
item.description: Pope Leo XIV successfully had a portion of his right lung excised to treat a malignant nodule. The Vatican confirmed that the scheduled surgical procedure proceeded without complications.

item.title: United Airlines Alters Qualifications for Elite Frequent Flyer Tiers
item.description: Starting in 2027, United Airlines will eliminate flight segments as a qualification metric for Premier status. The carrier is also raising financial expenditure thresholds required to attain Premier 1K level.

item.title: Tottenham Striker Richarlison Relegated to Under-21 Squad
item.description: Forward Richarlison has been excluded from Tottenham's primary Premier League roster. The sixty million pound striker is currently playing matches with the under-21 team instead.

item.title: Lawmakers Urge Trump to Cancel Russian Diesel Pact
item.description: Twelve senators, including six Republicans, urged the president to cancel his agreement with Vladimir Putin that permits Russian diesel sales worldwide, labeling the pact a betrayal of Ukraine.

item.title: Scotland Defeats Czech Republic to Reach Sweden Play-off
item.description: Scotland overcame the Czech Republic 3-2 to secure a 5-2 aggregate victory. This win advances them to a Women's World Cup play-off final against Sweden.

item.title: Ancient Russian Tomb Reveals Human Sacrifice and Protective Cup
item.description: Archaeologists in Russia uncovered a 2,000-year-old elite warrior grave containing a human sacrifice. The burial site also featured a protective cup designed to block magical dangers.

item.title: Pope Leo Diagnosed With Lung Cancer Following Surgery
item.description: The Vatican announced that 71-year-old Pope Leo has lung cancer after surgeons successfully removed the lower lobe of his right lung in Rome on Tuesday.

item.title: Anthropic Warns AI Models Nearing Self-Replication on Smart Devices
item.description: Anthropic warns that artificial intelligence models could soon achieve self-replication. Researchers note that malicious AI worms might soon target connected household electronics.

item.title: Missiles Intercepted Near Riyadh After Yemen Fuel Depot Strike
item.description: A fuel storage facility close to Sanaa was targeted by the Saudi-led military coalition operating in Yemen. Following the strike, incoming missiles were intercepted near Riyadh.

item.title: Cambridge Heavy Industries Developing Compact Fusion Device
item.description: Startup firm Cambridge Heavy Industries is secretly developing a small desktop fusion apparatus. The laser-driven device aims to support future commercial fusion energy facilities.

item.title: কলকাতায় সিইসির পদত্যাগের দাবিতে তৃণমূলের মিছিল আটকে দিল পুলিশ
item.description: ভারতের প্রধান নির্বাচন কমিশনার জ্ঞানেশ কুমারের পদত্যাগ ও ভোটার তালিকা সংশোধনের বিরোধিতায় কলকাতার মঙ্গলবার তৃণমূল কংগ্রেসের প্রতিবাদ মিছিল আটকে দেয় পুলিশ।

item.title: California Resident's $2 Vintage Photo Appraised at $5 Million
item.description: In 2010, Randy Guijarro bought an old picture for two dollars that is thought to feature Billy the Kid. Specialists evaluated the image at five million dollars following years of investigation into its genuineness.

item.title: Koos Bekker's Somerset Estate Reaches 2,700 Acres Amid Debate
item.description: Koos Bekker bought Hadspen House in 2013, expanding it into The Newt in Somerset across more than 2,700 acres. While the development creates local jobs and draws tourists, community opinions on the expansion are mixed.

item.title: Duane Davis Sentenced to 40 Years to Life for Tupac Shakur Murder
item.description: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis was given a sentence of 40 years to life for killing rapper Tupac Shakur. Prosecutors argued that Davis planned the shooting and made money from a book about his role.

item.title: Former Gang Leader Receives 40-Year Sentence for Tupac Shakur Killing
item.description: Davis received a 40-year prison sentence following his conviction last month for masterminding the 1996 drive-by shooting that killed renowned rapper Tupac Shakur.

item.title: Researchers Demand Stricter Artificial Intelligence Regulations
item.description: Experts are requesting stricter oversight of artificial intelligence to stop worldwide cybersecurity threats. This appeal arrives as surveys reveal skepticism regarding political figures' capability to handle AI dangers.

item.title: Licube Aims to Supply Lithium for Future Fusion Energy Facilities
item.description: Fusion energy facilities will require substantial amounts of lithium. Licube is positioning itself to become a primary supplier for this emerging industry.

item.title: Walmart Offers Free Insulin and Weight-Loss Drugs for Staff
item.description: Walmart will provide specific inhalers, insulin, and medications like Ozempic and Mounjaro completely free for employees with Type 2 diabetes who meet prior authorization requirements.

item.title: Transfer Rumors: Pedro Porro Eyes Potential Return to La Liga
item.description: Tottenham player Pedro Porro is reportedly interested in transferring to Barcelona. Meanwhile, various English teams are pursuing striker Dion Beljo, and Chelsea considers a move for Frenkie de Jong.

item.title: iOS 27.2 Beta Introduces Monochrome Apple Music Icon
item.description: The most recent developer version of iOS 27.2 features a modified Apple Music logo that swaps its traditional red backdrop for a black-and-white aesthetic. Additionally, the musical note graphic within the icon has been adjusted to display a more pointed angle.

item.title: Public Reaction Divided Over AI Tools for Biological Age Estimation
item.description: Following the creation of artificial intelligence software designed to determine a person's biological age, a survey of readers showed varying levels of trust. While some expressed interest in the technology, others remained skeptical about utilizing AI for personal health metrics.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV Scheduled for Lung Nodule Surgery in Rome
item.description: The 71-year-old pontiff will have a lung nodule removed at Rome's Gemelli hospital this week and is expected to recover in about a week before upcoming travels.

item.title: Internal Friction Reported in Madhya Pradesh BJP Following Recent Remarks
item.description: Comments made by former Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan have led to speculation regarding a divide within the state's ruling party. These developments suggest a strained relationship between senior leaders and current Chief Minister Mohan Yadav.

item.title: আইএফআইসি ব্যাংকের ৫০ বছর পূর্তি উদ্‌যাপন
item.description: গত ৮ অক্টোবর আইএফআইসি ব্যাংক তাদের ৫০তম প্রতিষ্ঠাবার্ষিকী পালন করেছে। এ উপলক্ষে রাজধানীর আইএফআইসি টাওয়ারসহ সারা দেশের বিভিন্ন শাখায় বিশেষ অনুষ্ঠানের আয়োজন করা হয়। গত শনিবার ব্যাংকের প্রধান কার্যালয়ে আয়োজিত এক অনুষ্ঠানে এই মাইলফলকটি উদযাপন করা হয়।

item.title: High Water Levels Lead to Dismantling of Iguazu Falls Walkway
item.description: Officials have taken down the Devil’s Throat pedestrian path at Iguazu Falls due to extreme flooding. The river's volume reached nearly eight times its usual flow, necessitating the removal of the structure for safety.

item.title: Ebola Infections Exceed 9,000 in DRC as Containment Efforts Struggle
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded over 9,000 cases of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, marking its most severe outbreak. Medical workers are finding it difficult to stop the virus's spread due to a lack of trust from local communities.

item.title: বাংলাদেশে লোটোর ১৫ বছর পূর্ণ; কাপাসিয়ায় নতুন কারখানা স্থাপন
item.description: স্পোর্টি লাইফস্টাইল ব্র্যান্ড লোটো বাংলাদেশে তাদের কার্যক্রমের দেড় দশক পূর্ণ করেছে। এই উপলক্ষে গত ৭ অক্টোবর রাজধানীর গুলশান ক্লাবে আয়োজিত এক অনুষ্ঠানে কাপাসিয়ায় নতুন একটি কারখানা চালু করার ঘোষণা দেওয়া হয়। অনুষ্ঠানে প্রতিষ্ঠানের ব্যবস্থাপনা পরিচালক কাজী জামিল ইসলাম বক্তব্য রাখেন।

item.title: Duane Davis Sentenced to Minimum 40 Years for Murder of Tupac Shakur
item.description: A judge has sentenced former gang leader Duane Davis to at least 40 years in prison for his role in the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur. Despite previously admitting his involvement in various media, Davis attempted to deny the charges during his trial.

item.title: Saudi coalition bombs Yemen fuel facilities following Houthi strikes
item.description: Following deadly Houthi drone and missile strikes targeting locations in Saudi Arabia, the coalition launched airstrikes against Yemen Petroleum Company oil installations. Civilians had previously been told to clear the area near the capital.

item.title: US ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle dismissed by Trump
item.description: Kimberly Guilfoyle was removed from her diplomatic post by the Trump administration amid claims of misconduct. She denied any wrongdoing, describing her time as ambassador as a major privilege.

item.title: প্রবাসীদের মিলনমেলা প্রশান্ত মহাসাগরের তীরে
item.description: প্রশান্ত মহাসাগরের উপকূলের সবুজ মাঠে পরিবার ও বন্ধুদের নিয়ে আনন্দঘন সময় কাটিয়েছেন প্রবাসী বাংলাদেশিরা। ঐতিহ্যবাহী খাবার, গান আর খেলাধুলার মধ্য দিয়ে তারা ছুটির দিনটি উপভোগ করেন।
